drafter.private_reasoning: The draft contains an internal header/footer note revealing confidential settlement authority. Remove it entirely. The substantive edits make the response more useful and preserve appropriate objections without inventing facts about what has been located or produced.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Counsel: Attached is Defendant’s revised response. Defendant will conduct a reasonable search for responsive, non-privileged materials and produce responsive documents subject to its stated objections. If you believe any request requires clarification or a discussion of scope, please let us know so the parties can confer.

edits.text: 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks information protected from disclosure by the attorney-client privilege, the work-product doctrine, or any other applicable privilege or protection. Defendant further objects to each request to the extent it is vague, ambiguous, overbroad, unduly burdensome, or seeks information not relevant to any claim or defense or not proportional to the needs of the case. These objections are stated only to the extent applicable to a particular request and do not relieve Defendant of its obligation to respond to the extent a request is reasonably understood and seeks discoverable information.

2. PRODUCTION. Subject to and without waiving the foregoing objections, Defendant will conduct a reasonable search for documents responsive to the requests and produce non-privileged responsive documents in its possession, custody, or control, to the extent they are located after a reasonable search. Defendant will produce documents on a rolling basis as they are collected and reviewed. Defendant will meet and confer regarding any request for which clarification or agreement on scope may facilitate a proportionate search and production.

3. PRIVILEGE LOG. To the extent Defendant withholds responsive documents based on a claim of privilege or protection, Defendant will identify the withheld documents in a privilege log in accordance with the applicable rules and any agreement of the parties, unless the parties agree otherwise or a log is not required.
4. RESERVATION. Defendant reserves the right to amend or supplement these responses as permitted or required by the applicable rules.
